question: What is the chemical name for slaked lime?
solution:
__
 
• **Calcium hydroxide**__ with the chemical formula Ca(OH)2 is also called as slaked lime.
 
• When quicklime reacts with water it produces slaked lime.
 
CaO + H₂O → Ca(OH)₂

 
 
• It is used for mortar, plaster, and cement in buildings.
 
• It is also an important chemical for raising the of potable water.
